@@ -60,11 +60,11 @@ setup_zsh() {
 	CMD_CHSH=$(command -v lchsh || command -v chsh || true)
 
 	if [ -n "$CMD_CHSH" ]; then
-		command -v zsh | sudo $CMD_CHSH $(whoami)
+		command -v zsh | sudo $CMD_CHSH $(whoami) || true
 	fi
 
 	# install zsh plugins ;-)
-	zsh -il -c true
+	TERM=xterm-256color zsh -il -c true
 }
 
 main "$@"
